data.text: Translation quality depends on context, terminology, and the structure of the original document. A useful system should preserve numbers, dates, and product names while producing natural sentences. This benchmark compares the same full precision model on the CPU and the GPU. It measures the delay before the first output token and the time spent generating subsequent tokens, while checking the translated text and the numerical differences between the two implementations.

exploration.note: Candidate measurements are exploratory, from separate worker runs, not a unified benchmark. Regressions/no gain were discarded.

limits: Small fixed corpus and one M2/24 GiB machine; not a broad quality evaluation or a speed guarantee.
Readiness is later because the fixed prefixes are computed before it. Prefix preparation time and total startup are both recorded.
OS caching, GPU clocks and memory pressure vary between processes; actual retention and I/O are reported.
31B real inference remains unverified because its full BF16 model does not fit this machine.
